title: Lekishon and the cows
author: Paul Maseri
pages:
This is Lekishon.
Lekishon is calling
his dog.

Lekishon and his dog
are going to graze
the animals.
The sun is hot.

Lekishon and his dog
are thirsty and hungry.

They go to look
for water.

Lekishon loses track
of his cows.

He decides to go
home with his dog.

The cows found
the way home!
Lekishon and his dog
are very happy.
